Full-response latency in milliseconds: bars are P50, dots P95. Customer service (8 Boolean questions), P50/P95: Open-Jev-2B 85.0/133.9; Jev 295.3/330.4; GPT-5.6 Luna 918.1/1443.1; GPT-6 Astra 1938.4/2375.7. Larger candidate set (1024 state tokens, 32 candidates): 2B 1015.9/1369.7; Jev 301.4/361.2; Luna 690.1/787.9; Astra 1388.1/1741.1. Lower is faster. Warm 2B on one H100 via loopback HTTP, cache off; others use remote HTTPS with undisclosed hardware. 20 measured calls after 3 warmups; concurrency 1, fresh connections. Luna reasoning none; Astra low. OpenAI server prompt caching occurred. These are different deployments, not a hardware-controlled speedup. No throughput or energy measurement. Two examples from 11 workloads, measured September 20, 2026.
